guard_pathway_0.m: Halt! No one is allowed down the pathway to the Duleian Road!
r: Never mind. Shadow be with you.

guard_pathway_1.m: Because a storm recently knocked over some trees that now block the passage. A villager even got hurt. And now the woodcutter that should be responsible doesn't want to cut the fallen trees away.
r: Why doesn't he want to do this work?

guard_pathway_2.m: You're really curious kid... Well our superior, the guard captain, only wants to pay the woodcutter when he has done his work.
r: Well, this is your problem. Goodbye.
You're right, but I'd really love to be able to take this path.

guard_pathway_4.m: OK, maybe you can be of use. Talk to the guard captain. Maybe you can convince him to pay the woodcutter first. But I have to warn you, he is a stubborn beast.
r: OK, thanks for your advice. I'm going to do that!

guard_pathway_5.m: Hello again. It seems like you have sorted things out. Now the passage isn't blocked anymore. You have my gratitude for doing that.
r: You're welcome. I'm glad the way is opened again!

guard_pathway_6.m: Hello kid. Did you make any progress on your task?
r: I wasn't able to convince the warden but I'm going to talk to the woodcutter now.
The woodcutter is going to help me if I retrieve his axe!

guard_pathway_7.m: Well good luck with that. Maybe you can convince him.

pathway_fallhaven: A path to the Duleian Road

pathway_fallhaven.10: I talked to a guard in the east of Fallhaven. He watches over the old passage to the Duleian Road, which is now blocked by fallen trees. If I want to help opening the path I should talk to his superior, the guard captain in the Fallhaven prison.
pathway_fallhaven.20: I talked to the guard captain. I wasn't able to convince him, but he advised me to talk to the woodcutter Jakrar, who lives just south of Fallhaven's prison.
pathway_fallhaven.30: I talked to Jakrar the woodcutter. He will only clear the trees away if I do him a favor. I should search for his favorite axe east of the Crossroads Guardhouse, located to the north of Fallhaven. I should keep my eyes open for an evil wolf pack.
pathway_fallhaven.40: I showed Jakrar the axe I found and he recognized it immediately.
pathway_fallhaven.50: Jakrar was very happy to see his good old axe again. He expressed his gratitude, and started to clear away the trees immediately.
pathway_fallhaven.60: Now the woodcutter has cleared away all the trees that blocked the path. Finally, the townsfolk have got back their shortcut to the Duleian Road!

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
